Cost [page]: Cost per task / Cost per successful task — USD; per-suite total cost and task counts in cost.csv; site shows cost per task and cost per successful task = (cost per task / score) x 100 · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/cost.csv
Cost [page]: $/1M out — USD output price per 1M tokens (also input_price_per_million in cost.csv), shown in the cost chart tooltip · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Time [page]: Inference time per task — mean seconds spent in LLM calls per task, per suite (llm_time.csv, with task counts n_/nq_) · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/llm_time.csv
Tokens [page]: avg output tokens — average output tokens per task, overall and per suite (cost.csv: avg_input_tokens, avg_output_tokens, out_<suite>); output tokens shown in cost chart tooltip · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/cost.csv
Effort [page]: Effort: — one entry per model at its highest supported effort (max/xhigh/high), shown in model details and in the name when not max, e.g. 'Claude Fable 5.2 (xhigh)'; no separate rows per effort level in the current release · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Breakdown [page]: Suite columns + Subcategories — 7 suite scores per model plus subcategory scores per suite (e.g. Long Agentic: Finance & Compliance Apps, Long-Run Operations, ...) · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/breakdown.json
Other [page]: Open weights — open-weight flag (filter chip; openweight + Hugging Face link in model catalog) · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Other [page]: Organization / Finetune from / Base model — model organization column ('Show org') and finetune provenance · https://livebench.ai/static/js/main.099aad9b.js
Other [data]: Unmeasured tasks — nq_<suite> counts of measured tasks in cost/time files; unmeasured tasks score 0 · https://livebench.ai/data/20261106/llm_time.csv
Not reported: speed, uncertainty, runs, date, votes

Date [page]: Released / Score vs. Release Date — model release date (e.g. 'released on November 9, 2026'); index chart against release date · https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-fable-5-2
Breakdown [page]: Capability Indexes / per-evaluation scores — capability indexes and per-evaluation scores (AA-Briefcase, Terminal-Bench 4.1, HLE-Diamond, ...) and domain indexes (Finance & Accounting, Legal, ...) on model and evaluation pages · https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-fable-5-2

Other [page]: Open Weights / Proprietary (Weights filter) — open-weights flag · https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-fable-5-2

Time [page]: Latency — seconds to first answer token incl. thinking time; sourced from Artificial Analysis · https://benchlm.ai/
Speed [page]: Tok/s — output tokens per second (median tokens/s), sourced from Artificial Analysis · https://benchlm.ai/data/speed.json
Uncertainty [page]: 90% interval — 90% posterior interval on the overall score (scoreInterval90 lower/upper, e.g. 88.5-98.0) · https://benchlm.ai/data/leaderboard.json
Effort [page]: Reasoning / Scores by reasoning effort — Reasoning type column (Reasoning / Non-Reasoning / Hybrid); some separate entries per mode (e.g. 'Grok 4 Fast (Reasoning)', 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 Thinking'); model pages list upstream results per effort level (Low..Max), but the overall score uses one setting per benchmark · https://benchlm.ai/md/models/claude-fable-5-2.md
Date [page]: Released — model release date (releaseDate, e.g. 2026-11-09) · https://benchlm.ai/models/claude-fable-5-2
Breakdown [page]: AG, CO, RE, MM, KN, ML, IF, MA + per-benchmark scores — 8 category scores (agentic, coding, reasoning, multimodal grounded, knowledge, multilingual, instruction following, math) and every per-benchmark score in its native unit, each with 'Who ran it' and source link · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Elo — 'Elo rating' column (e.g. 1502.18); the page does not state its source · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Parameters (B) — model size in billions or 'Not disclosed' · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Context — context window (e.g. 1M) · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Open / closed, License — open-weights flag and license (e.g. Proprietary) · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Status — Current / deprecated · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Supported / Estimated (evidenceStatus) — evidence status of the overall score · https://benchlm.ai/
Other [page]: Who ran it — per-score provenance: 'Reported by <lab>' (self-reported), 'Run by <evaluator>', 'Independent run', 'Carried from an upstream page' · https://benchlm.ai/md/models/claude-fable-5-2.md
Other [data]: trustedBenchmarkCount / scoreConfidence — number of trusted benchmarks behind the score and a 1-3 confidence level · https://benchlm.ai/data/leaderboard.json

Name: Chatbot Arena (LMArena)
Focus: Blind, crowdsourced A/B testing of model responses ranked via Elo ratings.
Yugos use?: Chatbot Arena (LMArena): ❌ Yugos uses Arena-Hard v2 questions instead
Metrics: quality*, cost*, tokens*, uncertainty*, effort*, date*, breakdown*, votes*, other*
Metrics detail:
Quality [data]: rating (Arena Score) — Bradley-Terry rating (Elo-scale) from pairwise human votes; text, vision, search, document, webdev, image/video arenas · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/text/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Quality [data]: score (IPS score τ̂) — Agent Arena aggregate uses IPS scores (fraction, e.g. 0.274) instead of Bradley-Terry · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Quality [data]: index_score / raw_score — Agent Arena per-signal subsets (e.g. agent_tool_efficiency): index score (~1200 scale) and raw rate (0-1) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent_tool_efficiency/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Cost [data]: cost_per_task_p50 — Agent Arena aggregate only: median cost per task (USD, e.g. 9.15) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Tokens [data]: output_tokens_per_task_p50 — Agent Arena aggregate only: median output tokens per task · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Uncertainty [data]: rating_lower / rating_upper — lower/upper confidence bound of the Arena Score · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Uncertainty [data]: variance — rating variance · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Uncertainty [data]: score_ci_lower / score_ci_upper — 95% CI bounds for Agent Arena IPS score (index_score_ci_*/raw_score_ci_* in signal subsets) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Effort [data]: model_name suffix, e.g. 'Gemini 4 Carbon (High)', 'Claude Opus 5.5 (Max)' — reasoning-effort variants listed as separate entries via the model name · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/text/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Date [data]: leaderboard_publish_date — date the leaderboard snapshot with this score was published (YYYY-MM-DD), not model release date · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Breakdown [data]: category — per-category ratings in addition to overall (text: coding, math, hard_prompts, creative_writing, languages, exclude_ties, expert, industry splits, etc.; agent signals: overall/chat/code/work); plus separate arenas (text, vision, webdev, search, document, image, video, agent) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/text/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Votes [data]: vote_count — number of battles (human votes) for the model · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Votes [data]: observation_count / session_count — Agent Arena: signal observations and distinct user sessions per model · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/resolve/main/agent/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet
Other [data]: license — model license (e.g. Proprietary, open licenses) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Other [data]: organization — model creator · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Other [data]: rank — rank within the leaderboard · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Other [data]: style control subsets (e.g. text_style_control) — separate rating tables with style control (site default for text/vision since 2025-05-16) · https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/main/README.md
Not reported: time, speed, runs

Name: MRCR / RULER
Focus: Multi-needle retrieval and reasoning across massive context windows (128k–2M+ tokens).

Metrics detail:
Quality [page]: Avg. — RULER: average score (0-100, % of 13 tasks solved; no unit in table) over 4K-128K context lengths · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Quality [page]: wAvg. (inc) / wAvg. (dec) — RULER: weighted averages over context lengths with weights increasing / decreasing linearly with length, each followed by the rank, e.g. '95.7 (1st)'; 'TBD' for newer rows · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Quality [page]: OpenAI-MRCR: 2 needle 128k / 2 needle 1M — OpenAI-MRCR: accuracy in %, in the 'Long context evals' appendix table of the GPT-4.1 post (the dataset card's 'Results' section points there); OpenAI models only · https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/
Effort [page]: o1 (high), o3-mini (high) — OpenAI-MRCR table: reasoning effort appears only in the model column header, one setting per model; RULER has none · https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/
Breakdown [page]: 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K — RULER: score per context length (values above the Llama-2-7B 4K threshold of 85.6 are underlined); no per-task or per-category scores · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Breakdown [page]: 2 needle / 4 needle / 8 needle — OpenAI-MRCR: chart tabs on the GPT-4.1 post ('OpenAI MRCR accuracy, 2 needle', ...) give accuracy vs input length per needle count; the table gives only 2-needle at 128k and 1M · https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-1/
Other [page]: Claimed Length — RULER: context length claimed by the model developer (e.g. 128K, 1M) · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Other [page]: Effective Length — RULER: longest length where the score exceeds the 85.6 threshold (e.g. '>128K', '8K', '<4K') · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Other [page]: Models (size in parentheses) — RULER: parameter count after the model name, e.g. '(7B)', '(94B/398B)' · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Other [page]: * after model name — RULER: results reported by the model authors (listed in 'Notes' under the table), not run by NVIDIA · https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER
Not reported: cost, time, speed, tokens, uncertainty, runs, date, votes
Note: Two separate sources: RULER = README results table (open models, per-context-length); OpenAI-MRCR = no leaderboard, only results in OpenAI's GPT-4.1 announcement (Apr 14, 2025).
